notes.title: Official release of the game in v1.0 !
notes.notes:
The Last Strand is now available in version 1.0, after 2 months of Early Access.

Come fight new bosses, discover brand-new item interactions, and take on difficult challenges.

notes.title: Version 0.10.2 is out !
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]

- room with four rewards : can only pick one
- "Golden Compass" now updates the room type directly 


[b]improvements[/b]

- Add a "normal" difficulty mode (making it clearer that "easy" is for beginners)
- Improve "Explosive Barrel" sprite : change the color to make them easier to spot
- Improve animation : Add a visiual indicator when a "Parrot" is about the dash
- Slow down "boomrang" so they are easier to shoot at
- Update "fire trap cannon" to be easier to be differenciate with regular "trap cannon"
- Reduce a bit Fog density
- Chests are less likely to be spawn after a "Fight" room (for all difficulties)
- "Penta" (summoning circle) lasts a bit less
- Add sound effect for "Refill barrel" (more coming in the next patch)
- Item balance : decrease overall damage given by items + minor tweaks

notes.title: Early Access available NOW !
notes.notes:
Successful Early Access launch - play now in Early Access!

Will you manage to escape the ship or take your revenge?

notes.title: Steam Deck support
notes.notes: Good news for the Steam Deck users, the Last Strand can be played on Steam Deck ! I am still waiting for the official Steam stamp to be Steam Deck verified

notes.title: Version 0.10.1 is out !
notes.notes:
Last update before the Early Access release on 02/27!

Changes:

- Updated item descriptions to display values

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197873/22a1409cd537f9fc3ad1b1664d1277066c416ebe.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access announcement
notes.notes:
The Last Strand will be released on 27 Feb, 2025 ! 
The Early Access will include more than 150 items, 4 playable characters, 6 challenges and tons of bosses and enemies ! Expect more at the end of the EA.

In the meantime, don't forget to wishlist the game to be notified

notes.title: The Last Strand will be present at Steam Next Fest: Octobre 2024
notes.notes:

Come test the game the 14th of october 2024.

The demo includes 2 un-lockable characters, 60 items, 20 regular ennemies and 15 bosses, and 2 special challenges !
